Practice GD&T engineering problems on Snubber → https://snubber.ai/gdt

Get better at engineering problem solving & technical interviews → https://snubber.ai

GD&T is much easier to understand when you stop memorizing symbols and start asking why the system exists. In Part I, we build Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing from first principles from the failures of plus-minus tolerancing to datums, tolerance zones, feature control frames, MMC, RFS, and more.

Chapters:
00:00 What Is GD&T?
01:26 Why Plus-Minus Dimensioning Fails
04:01 Degrees of Freedom & Datums
05:16 Datum Feature vs. Datum vs. Datum Feature Simulator
06:15 Geometric Tolerance Zones
07:30 How to Read a Feature Control Frame
08:44 Features of Size
09:36 Local Size vs. Mating Envelope
11:02 MMC, Rule #1 & RFS
